fields.label: Consolidation Group
fields.description: The acquiring group: the Consolidation Group root whose policy and declared accounts this deal is measured under.

fields.label: Acquisition Date
fields.description: The date control was obtained. It must fall inside a declared fiscal period; that period's closing rate translates the consideration.

fields.label: Share Acquired %
fields.description: Share of control obtained, 0 to 100. Below 100 the rest is the non-controlling interest.

fields.label: Consideration Currency
fields.description: Pre-filled from the group's reporting currency; consideration lines may still be in other currencies.

fields.label: NCI Measurement
fields.description: Copied from the group root's Consolidation Policy when the deal is saved: partial or full.

fields.label: Ownership Period
fields.description: Created or linked on approval: effective from the acquisition date at the share acquired.

fields.label: Consideration
fields.description: What was given for control, by IFRS 3 component. At least one line.

fields.label: Acquired Balances
fields.description: The entity's balance sheet at acquisition with fair value adjustments per line. Required when no trial balance of the entity exists at or before the acquisition period; otherwise the trial balance is used.

fields.label: Costs
fields.description: Legal, advisory and due diligence costs. Expensed or capitalised according to the group's Consolidation Policy.

fields.label: Purchase Price Allocation
fields.description: Computed when the deal is saved, in the group's reporting currency.

fields.label: Total Consideration
fields.description: Sum of the consideration lines translated at the acquisition period's closing rate.

fields.label: Net Assets Acquired
fields.description: Sum of the acquired balance sheet book amounts.

fields.label: Fair Value Adjustments
fields.description: Sum of the fair value adjustment lines.

fields.label: Costs Expensed
fields.description: Acquisition costs taken to the Acquisition Costs account; zero when the policy capitalises them.

fields.label: Goodwill
fields.description: Consideration less the share of net assets at fair value, when positive.

fields.label: Bargain Purchase Gain
fields.description: The excess of the share of net assets at fair value over the consideration, when the policy recognises it.

fields.label: NCI at Acquisition
fields.description: Partial: the NCI share of net assets at fair value. Full: the NCI at fair value.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Set by the workflow: Approved is the submitted document, Cancelled the cancelled one.
